notes:
Summary: TidalVector is a legal-tech platform (contract search + clause extraction) migrating from an Elastic+custom-reranker stack to a vector-first RAG architecture. Priority is embeddings + reranker migration with evals-driven gating. They index ~25M docs (contracts, exhibits), expect growth. Key constraints: 95th pctl retrieval+rerank latency target (end-to-end) <= 200ms for single-query flows; cost target <= $0.005/query average; must preserve or improve current MRR@10 and precision@5.

Recent ask from CTO: 'we can accept modest latency increase for better precision but cannot accept regressions in legal recall or hallucination.' They requested an eval plan that ties automated metrics to human review for legal-critical queries.

Technical notes / risks:
- Current infra: Elastic for retrieval + small BERT-based reranker that runs on CPU -> good precision but high cost at scale.
- Proposed migration: embed with newer dense model (candidate embedding cost lower), use Redwood to host candidate index + lightweight neural reranker on Dedicated GPUs; explore quantized reranker for cost.
- Main concern: embedding drift causes ranking regressions on legacy queries; need paired-eval harness and canary A/B to demonstrate parity.
- Indexing scale: 25M docs (~300M tokens), need incremental reindexing pipeline; worried about initial ingest throughput and index size growth (shard strategy discussed).
- Operational: need SAML SSO + audit logging, KMS integration for keys, and EU residency for a subset of PII-containing contracts.

Evals plan discussed:
- Baseline metrics captured: MRR@10, precision@5, legal_recall_on_must_have_clauses (custom), false_positive_rate on confidentiality-sensitive retrievals.
- Running 4-way A/B: (current stack) vs (new embed + current reranker) vs (new embed + new reranker v1 quantized) vs (new embed + new reranker v2 fp16) across a 50k offline holdout. Gate: no metric drops >1.5% absolute in MRR or precision on legal-critical sets.
- Canary plan: 2% live traffic, shadowing 100% candidates, live rerank only for subset; collect feedback with rapid rollback if regression detected. Use Redwood rollouts + pinning.

Sales/Procurement notes:
- Budget: procurement expects TCO analysis comparing Dedicated reserved capacity vs private on-prem license. CFO requested a 3-year TCO.
- Competitive: evaluating Weaviate (managed), Elastic federated approach, and custom self-hosted. Decision likely Q2 2025.

Stubs / links: pricing deck in Drive, security FAQ; asked for a bulleted POC runbook and estimated Dedicated GPU hours. AE action: deliver cost model + POC runbook by 2025-03-05. SE action: set up eval harness and initial reindex test cluster (sized for 5M docs) by 2025-03-01.

Quote from legal lead (call 2025-02-20): 'If the new embeddings miss clause matches we will have compliance exposure — need human-in-loop validations for first 6 months.'
